title: Quaint Sweet Syrian Ladyfingers Trifle
description: A sweet and crumbly Syrian dessert featuring ladyfingers and bonito shave, perfect for vegetarians. This nostalgic dish is a delightful treat for any occasion.
instructions: Dip each ladyfinger into a mixture of rose water and orange blossom water for about 3-5 seconds on each side.
Arrange a layer of ladyfingers in the bottom of a large serving dish.
Sprinkle a layer of granulated sugar over the ladyfingers.
Drizzle a layer of melted butter over the sugar.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of sugar on top.
Sprinkle bonito shave over the top layer of sugar.
Whip the heavy cream until it forms stiff peaks and spread over the top of the trifle.
Refrigerate the trifle for at least 3 hours before serving.
Garnish with chopped pistachios before serving.
